languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_find_symbol
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Locate a symbol (function, class, or variable) by name in the current workspace. Returns the file path and line number where the symbol is defined.

name.description: The symbol name to search for (e.g. a function, class, or variable name)

level.description: Optional search depth hint. Defaults to 1.

hints.description: Whether to include location hints in the result. Defaults to true.

compress.description: Whether to request a more compact backend response. Defaults to false.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_get_change_impact
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show what would break if a symbol were changed or renamed. Returns the list of directly and transitively affected files and callers in the workspace.

name.description: The symbol name to analyse for change impact

max_direct.description: Optional cap for direct impact matches. Defaults to 20.

max_transitive.description: Optional cap for transitive impact matches. Defaults to 50.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_get_dependencies
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show what a symbol or module depends on. Returns the full dependency chain for the given symbol in the current workspace.

name.description: The symbol name to trace dependencies for

max_results.description: Optional cap for dependency matches. Defaults to 20.

compress.description: Whether to request a more compact backend response. Defaults to false.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_get_workspace_profile
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return the extension-managed workspace profile, including detected repo type, languages, frameworks, test commands, risk areas, and refresh status. Read-only and backend-optional.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_detect_phase
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return the current extension-managed lifecycle phase assessment for the workspace, including confidence and reasons. Read-only and backend-optional.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_get_next_actions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return a concise list of safe, read-only next-step suggestions derived from workspace profile, lifecycle phase, refresh state, and project memory.

max_actions.description: Optional cap for the number of recommended next actions to return.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_get_recent_run_summary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Summarize the most recent preview or action runs recorded by the extension in this workspace session. Read-only and backend-optional.

max_runs.description: Optional cap for the number of recent runs to summarize.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_get_project_memory_summary
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return the extension-owned project memory summary, including project purpose, stack, conventions, current goals, and source fingerprints. Read-only and backend-optional.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_get_context_bundle
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return a bounded read-only context bundle that combines workspace profile, lifecycle phase, project memory summary, recent run summaries, test commands, warnings, and next actions.

max_actions.description: Optional cap for how many next actions to include in the context bundle.

max_runs.description: Optional cap for how many recent runs to include in the context bundle.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_list_test_commands
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List test and validation commands detected from workspace state and project memory. Read-only and backend-optional.

languageModelTools.name: agent-platform_discover_project_actions
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Discover likely project actions from workspace state and optionally enrich them with backend-discovered runnable actions. This tool is read-only and does not execute any action.

include_backend_actions.description: Whether to include backend-discovered runnable actions when a backend read provider is available. Defaults to true.

agentPlatform.pythonPath.description: Optional absolute path to the Python executable used to launch the Agent-Platform backend.

agentPlatform.backend.enabled.description: Enable the Agent-Platform Python backend tool provider. Set to false to run the agent without any tool provider (direct-answer mode only).

agentPlatform.serviceModule.description: Python module path for the Token Savior internal service transport.

agentPlatform.modelProvider.description: Preferred model provider for future Token Savior orchestration.

agentPlatform.copilotModelFamily.description: Optional VS Code language model family selector for the Copilot-backed provider.

agentPlatform.copilotModelId.description: Optional exact VS Code language model id for the Copilot-backed provider.

agentPlatform.localModelLabel.description: Display label for the configured local model provider.

agentPlatform.localEndpoint.description: Base URL of the local model runtime (for Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible server).

agentPlatform.localModelName.description: Model name served by the local runtime, for example llama3.1:8b or mistral.

agentPlatform.localApiFormat.description: Protocol used by the local model runtime.

agentPlatform.localApiKey.description: Optional API key for an OpenAI-compatible local model endpoint.

agentPlatform.commandApprovalMode.description: Approval policy for project action commands.

agentPlatform.destructiveApprovalMode.description: Approval policy for destructive tools like checkpoint restore.

agentPlatform.autoSaveProjectMemory.description: Automatically save approved mutating workflow outcomes and eligible tool-backed preview runs to project memory.

agentPlatform.persistRunHistory.description: Persist recent preview runs in workspace state so they survive extension-host restarts.

agentPlatform.automationProfile.description: Controls how much read-only always-on automation runs in the background. Conservative keeps refreshes minimal, balanced is the default, and aggressive-but-safe refreshes more often without silently mutating the workspace.

agentPlatform.refreshDebounceMs.description: Debounce window, in milliseconds, for automatic workspace refreshes triggered by file activity.

agentPlatform.profileScanEntryLimit.description: Maximum number of prioritized top-level workspace entries scanned when deriving the workspace profile.

agentPlatform.projectMemorySourceFileLim.description: Maximum number of canonical docs and config files scanned when refreshing the extension-owned project memory snapshot.

agentPlatform.actionDiscoveryLimit.description: Maximum number of likely project actions retained during automatic workspace profiling.

agentPlatform.maxWorkspaceSuggestions.description: Maximum number of always-on workspace suggestions retained for observability and Copilot context.

agentPlatform.maxContextBundleChars.description: Maximum character budget for the runtime context bundle injected into model prompts.

agentPlatform.staleStateThresholdMinutes.description: Age threshold, in minutes, after which the last successful workspace refresh is considered stale.

agentPlatform.suggestionNoiseThreshold.description: Minimum number of added or removed suggestions that counts as noisy churn for observability telemetry.

agentPlatform.toolTimeoutMs.description: Per-tool-call timeout in milliseconds. Calls exceeding this are failed gracefully.

agentPlatform.maxContextTokens.description: Maximum token budget for context injected into planning prompts.

scripts.package:precheck: npm test && npm run test:extension-host && npm run test:mutation-e2e
scripts.package: npm run compile && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); fs.mkdirSync('.artifacts',{recursive:true}); const out=path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); const cli=path.join('node_modules','@vscode','vsce','vsce'); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[cli,'package','--no-dependencies','--out',out],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(result.error){console.error(result.error); process.exit(1);} process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run package && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const vsix=path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); if(!fs.existsSync(vsix)){console.error(`Missing VSIX artifact: ${vsix}`); process.exit(1);} console.log(`Dry-run artifact ready: ${vsix}`);"
scripts.publish:vsce: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const token=process.env.VSCE_PAT; if(!token){console.error('VSCE_PAT is required'); process.exit(1);} const packagePath=process.env.VSIX_PATH || path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); const cli=path.join('node_modules','@vscode','vsce','vsce'); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[cli,'publish','--packagePath',packagePath,'-p',token],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(result.error){console.error(result.error); process.exit(1);} process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
scripts.publish:ovsx: node -e "const path=require('node:path'); const pkg=require('./package.json'); const {spawnSync}=require('node:child_process'); const token=process.env.OVSX_PAT; if(!token){console.error('OVSX_PAT is required'); process.exit(1);} const packagePath=process.env.VSIX_PATH || path.join('.artifacts', `${pkg.name}-${pkg.version}.vsix`); const cli=path.join('node_modules','ovsx','bin','ovsx'); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,[cli,'publish',packagePath,'--pat',token],{stdio:'inherit'}); if(result.error){console.error(result.error); process.exit(1);} process.exit(result.status ?? 1);"
